uncultured.finding: One image filename suggested a messaging-app asset but visual inspection showed a photographed printed document. A second 2017 screenshot remained in the already-sampled social-media family and preserved surrounding interface context.
uncultured.candidate: Context-preserving screenshot capture remains stable within one social-media family but is not yet generalized across apps.
uncultured.next: classify screenshots from pixels/content rather than filename and seek visually verified non-social-media captures

terminus.finding: A 2014 blacksmith-street field interview shows machines reducing routine handmade demand while one-off repair and adaptive fabrication remain valuable because setup costs can exceed the value of a single repair and the work requires tacit judgment, dimensional reasoning and responses to non-repeating problems. Rent, zoning, logistics and redevelopment can still erase the ecosystem that sustains this residual craft function.
terminus.candidate: Refined three-layer model: routine task substitution; residual adaptive/tacit function; institutional ecosystem conditions. Technology can replace the first without replacing the second, while institutions can still remove the habitat that lets the second survive.
terminus.next: test the three-layer model against unrelated domains such as teaching, care work, bureaucracy and media production

phase: small-batch mining with provenance-first, genre-aware scoring, media-class verification and active falsification
